GRADE 9 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living,
   B. Learners should ignore Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  completely.
   C. Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to .

2. About Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate Scriptural stories that portray the teachings of the Enlightened Beings for moral and social development,
   B. Learners should ignore Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  completely.
   C. Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to .

3. About Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living,
   B. Learners should ignore Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  completely.
   C. Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to .

5. About Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the role of Sikh Scriptures for guidance in one’s life,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 completely.
   C. Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17.

6. About Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 completely.
   C. Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17.

7. About Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret the universal message embedded in the Sri Sukhmani Sahib for deeper understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 completely.
   C. Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17.

9. About Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. state the Sikh Principles of Dharma for knowledge,
   B. Learners should ignore Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) completely.
   C. Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna).

10. About Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the concepts of the three pillars of Sikh Dharma for spiritual uplift,
   B. Learners should ignore Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) completely.
   C. Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna).

11. About Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. display the Sikh Principles of Dharma in a school environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) completely.
   C. Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna) is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sikh Principles of Dharma , Chhakna).
